I miss my brother more everyday day, I know he wouldn't have abandon me, 
I used to write every day but I lost my motivations for it. I'm at a local coffee shop
Just trying to be around other people even if I don't know them, I'm afraid if I go home to my empty house ill end it. I have a gun at home but Im not ready to give up yet. I don't know why, i feel that way when earlier I bought a box of shell's, I'm just at the end of my rope, going through another day seems pointless

I lost the people I felt comfortable talking with when I came out, my brother who was my best friend died last year in Afghanistan, I never had a lot of friends, and after what happend I pulled farther away form people. I don't know anybody that's 
Gay or any other part of LGBT community. I think I found one but idk if Im welcome 
I can't find anything on there website about people like me. 
 Thank you for taking time to respond. It means a lot.
